facts.text: Thompson Shanghai Expo is located at Expo Place, a commercial complex in the Shanghai World Expo area.
facts.excerpt: Thompson Shanghai Expo is a lifestyle hotel located at Expo Place, a landmark commercial complex in the heart of the Shanghai World Expo area

facts.text: The hotel's design is inspired by the area's industrial heritage.
facts.excerpt: Step into an urban retreat inspired by the area's rich industrial heritage and global spirit, celebrated through design, art, and gastronomy.

facts.text: Guest rooms feature artworks inspired by the Expo Pavilion.
facts.excerpt: Hardwood floors with hand-tufted rugs, custom furnishings in rich warm hues, and artworks inspired by the Expo Pavilion create havens of residential-style comfort.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city and Huangpu River views.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows that showcase inspiring city and Huangpu River views

facts.text: The Pavilion View king room looks out on the red structure of the China Art Museum, originally China's World Expo Pavilion.
facts.excerpt: The auspicious red structure of the China Art Museum, originally China's World Expo Pavilion, provides a striking view from this king-bed room

facts.text: The Metropolitan Suite is on the 18th floor and has a separate living room and bedroom.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 18th floor, our most spacious suite offers a premium vantage point to admire stunning views of the Huangpu River

facts.text: Suites include a Golden Hours benefit and turndown service.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in our spacious suites offering thoughtful extra touches, including Golden Hours benefit and turn down service.

facts.text: Rooms come with a Dyson hair dryer and Bluetooth speakers.
facts.excerpt:
Dyson hair dryer
  - Laptop-sized safe
  - Handed-iron and ironing board
  - Bluetooth speakers

facts.text: TOTS is the hotel's rooftop club destination with a 270-degree view.
facts.excerpt: taking in a spectacular 270-degree view as the sunset gives way to Shanghai's dazzling city lights

facts.text: TOTS serves specialty cocktails with Italian tapas and Chinese snacks to DJ music.
facts.excerpt: enjoying specialty cocktails complemented by Italian tapas and Chinese snacks as you unwind to a soundtrack of DJ music

facts.text: TOTS has cabanas with tableside service.
facts.excerpt: Or settle in for an evening in one of the cabanas with tableside service

facts.text: Fishermen's Pavilion serves Chinese cuisine built around seafood and freshwater fish from five coastal and riverine regions.
facts.excerpt: savor a refined dining experience where seafood and the high-quality freshwater fish from the rich waters of the five renowned coastal and riverine regions take center stage

facts.text: Fishermen's Pavilion has views of the Huangpu River and the Shanghai skyline.
facts.excerpt: Feast your eyes on the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline as you dine.

facts.text: BAOBAO Lounge, the lobby lounge, serves steamed delicacies and light bites and has an alfresco terrace overlooking a square.
facts.excerpt: Savor steamed delicacies and light bites alongside a selection of coffees, teas, cocktails and local beverages

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool plus sauna and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: heated indoor pool, allowing the warm water to soothe and refresh you. Then melt any lingering tension in our sauna and steam rooms

facts.text: The fitness center offers group fitness classes.
facts.excerpt: You can also enjoy the social atmosphere of a group fitness class

facts.text: Thompson Hall, the ballroom, spans 1,100 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Make an unforgettable impression in the Thompson Hall, one of the largest ballrooms in the Shanghai World Expo area, spanning 1,100 square meters.

facts.text: The Oval is an event space with a curved design.
facts.excerpt: Turn heads with an avant-garde party or fashion show amid the curved design of The Oval.
